original_test_intent: Verify the BIOS firmware version and the procedure's explicitly listed BMC and lower/upper GPUBB companion versions before and after an approved external firmware operation.
original_method: Capture same-SUT WebUI and approved read-only raw responses, decode each owner-confirmed component using the vendor schema and compare the protected before/after checkpoints with the target manifest.
manual_activity: The owner confirms the BIOS-versus-companion scope, commands and target builds and separately governs flashing; an operator verifies same-SUT checkpoints while automation performs only approved reads and comparisons.
required_inputs: Confirmed BIOS and companion component scope
Exact read-only requests and response schema
Target package manifest and protected before/after checkpoints
safety_requirements: Do not flash, reset, power-cycle or clear logs
Stop on malformed or mismatched component data
Use separately approved recovery for flashing
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Verify target and resolved component scope
Validate completion, length, byte order and mapping
Compare BIOS and confirmed companion values across checkpoints and manifest
Report without flashing or deciding the verdict
engineer_actions: Supply vendor commands, decoder and target builds
Provide separate flash/recovery evidence when applicable

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Completely inapplicable: the PSU inlet readings belong to duplicate row 772 and contain no firmware versions.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Replace every placeholder only with reviewed read-only requests from the matching BMC specification and keep firmware mutation outside this case.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BIOS item, named companion checks, before/after criterion, Script and 5/5-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a component-keyed before/after matrix containing raw response, completion, decoder version, decoded value and manifest comparison.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes title-versus-procedure scope explicit and isolates observation from mutation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No named component is silently dropped pending owner confirmation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Raw-command ambiguity can query or mutate the wrong function; a separate BIOS flash can affect bootability.

project_override_considerations: The project may confirm BIOS-only scope or retain all listed companion fields, and may use equivalent supported UI/API fields, but must document the decision, target mapping and any removed coverage.
expected_evidence: Resolved component scope and same-SUT identity
Raw and decoded BIOS plus confirmed companion values before/after
No-mutation proof and no hardware PASS claim

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The BIOS title is narrower than the procedure's multi-component inventory but not mutually exclusive; all explicit checks are preserved pending ordinary scope confirmation. Duplicate row 772 is isolated.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Scope, commands, decoder, target builds and checkpoints are finite package inputs; once supplied, read-only verification is feasible.

review_improvement: Removes PSU-sensor contamination, exposes rather than hides the scope expansion and prevents placeholder raw or firmware-mutation execution.
independent_technical_reasoning: The requested version observations are finite and read-only, but cannot be executed without the vendor schema and target manifest. Owner scope confirmation is a readiness input, so REQUIRES is warranted without declaring permanent blockage.
